s3.onlyWriter: Hydrate: ProjectionKernel.BeginHydrateTransaction/ApplyHydrateEvent/CommitHydrateTransaction. Live: unique Kernel ingest EventPublisher.publish → ProjectionKernel.IngestLive. iOS: ProjectionStore.applyFrame. kernel==nil → projection.Apply is a sealed second reducer, not a writer.
s3.transactionDomain: hydrate, live, reconnect, and projection delivery. Nested sync is an explicit skip domain, not an ingest domain.
s3.newDataPath: unique pre-Kernel normalization point: agent/opencode-web/events.go sseSubscriber.handleRawEvent unwraps payload then sseSubscriber.handleServerEvent is the exclusive type switch. nested sync skip: payload.type==sync is explicitly skipped at that unique point before any core.Event mapping (official server-sdk.tsx:284). Direct SSE maps to core.Event → go-bridge/events.go mapAgentEvent → unique Kernel ingest EventPublisher.publish → ProjectionKernel.IngestLive. reconnect same Kernel: validate/invalidate/rehydrate the same (backendId, sessionId) Kernel; history/status supply hydrate facts only. Direct+sync dual ingest is forbidden.
s3.activeWriteInventory: events.go handleRawEvent/handleServerEvent: mapper only. EventPublisher.publish → kernel.IngestLive: allowed unique live writer. projection_kernel.go hydrate transaction: allowed hydrate writer. event_publisher.go kernel==nil → p.projection.Apply: sealed second reducer, must be sealed unused. handlers_projection.go streamBackendRichHistoryProjectionEvents opencode-web: hydrate facts only. Nested sync ingest: forbidden. Consumer-side dedup/referee: forbidden. iOS history merge: sealed.
s3.failurePresentation: A3: APIError 400 isRetryable=false, retry statuses then idle; not a healthy completion. A4: abort → MessageAbortedError, idle, not finish=stop success. A5: busy-at-disconnect; reconnect first direct server.connected then live deltas; terminal idle on second SSE — never synthesize finish=stop from empty reload status. Missing terminal stays running/failed. No inferred success.

s3.name: model/agent

s3.onlyWriter: Control-plane catalog: models.go AvailableModels, agents.go ListAgents. Timeline writers remain Kernel + ProjectionStore. Unavailable choice must produce zero prompt POST.
s3.transactionDomain: request/control (catalog). Prompt field carry is C3; C5 owns fallback levels and connected-only catalog.
s3.newDataPath: GET /provider connected-only and GET /agent → AvailableModels/ListAgents. Fallback levels kept distinct: (1) current choice (2) agent model (3) configured default (4) recent (5) connected fallback. Only connected providers. No recursive catalog search. Selected model/agent ride C3 prompt_async; catalog refresh does not write SessionProjection.
s3.activeWriteInventory: models.go AvailableModels/fetchModelCatalog connected-only: catalog, allowed. session.go resolveSendModel: request-time choice, allowed control, must not invent ids. agents.go ListAgents: catalog, allowed. Recursive catalog JSON search: forbidden. Catalog rows into messages[]: forbidden. Unconnected provider POST: forbidden (zero prompt).
s3.failurePresentation: Unavailable/not-connected choice → zero prompt POST and a diagnosable model error. Missing catalog fails closed. Do not invent a model id. Distinct fixtures per fallback level; collapsing levels is a failure, not success.

s3.name: interaction
s3.truthOwner: OpenCode serve owns permission/question/todo facts (asked/replied/rejected; todo.updated items). Canonical permission state and canonical question state are reduced by Mac ProjectionKernel. Todos remain control-plane facts, not SessionProjection timeline. iOS ProjectionStore is the only SSV2 writer for projected permission/question cards.
s3.onlyWriter: Permission: Kernel reduces canonical permission_request/permission_resolved; raw control presentation must not write messages[]. Question: Kernel reduces canonical user_input_requested/user_input_resolved only. Todo: no timeline writer; control-plane publisher only if advertised. ProjectionStore applies projected cards.
s3.transactionDomain: live (canonical Kernel ingest for permission/question) plus explicit control-plane (permission raw presentation; todo). Not hydrate-as-messages for these surfaces.
s3.newDataPath: permission.asked SSE + GET /permission → handlePermissionAsked → EventPermissionRequest → unique Kernel ingest. Reply POST /session/:id/permissions/:id {response:once|always|reject} is control; reject is not a healthy completion. question.asked/replied/rejected → canonical user_input_requested/user_input_resolved into Kernel; do not invent official question_resolved; legacy question_asked/question_resolved are one-way presentation and must not enter Kernel or SSV2 raw. todo.updated + GET /todo {content,status,priority} no id → control-plane only; must not enter SessionProjection; do not create hash/content/position IDs.

Todo into SessionProjection: forbidden. Raw permission into messages[]: forbidden. Capability advertisement before full path: forbidden (frozen).

s4.name: OpenCode adapter
s4.invariant: direct SSE 与 nested sync 不能双 ingest；nested sync 在唯一 pre-Kernel normalization point 显式跳过；stable messageID 在 request、persisted user message、projection 间保持一致（correlation-only）；unsupported version/shape fail closed；source-only 行必须 capture-before-translator（先补同版本样本再写 translator 测试）。
s4.producerProof: adapter 只从 direct payload 产出 core.Event：handleRawEvent 解 envelope 后 handleServerEvent 是唯一类型开关；nested sync 在该点显式跳过（官方 server-sdk.tsx:284 规则）；unknown type log-and-drop 不当成功。
s4.reducerFenceProof: 一个上游语义事件最多推进一次 Kernel chain / syncRev（planned TestDirectAndSyncDoNotBothAdvanceSyncRev）；v2/unknown generation 零 Kernel ingest（planned TestV2FailClosedQuarantine）。
s4.deliveryClientProof: adapter 不向 SSV2 直投 raw；catalog/todo 等非 timeline 信号不进 chat stream（existing TestSSECatalogSignalsDoNotEnterChatStream / TestSSETodoUpdatedIgnoredInPhase1）。
s4.sampleEvidence: A1–A10 replay 归属明确：A1/A2/A3/A4/A5→C4；A6/A7/A8→C6；A9→C3；A10→C2/C7。source-only 行（workspace.project、content.reasoning、observation.external_turns、configuration.providers、configuration.default_model、sessions.rename、sessions.delete）与 selected variant 一律 capture-before-translator。
s4.negativeAssertion: unknown/unhandled SSE type 只 log debug 并 drop，不得视为成功或第二事件流；v2/unknown generation fail closed 零 ingest；unsupported part 在网络前失败零 POST；禁止 recursive JSON search 与 legacy parser fallback。
s4.exitCondition: A1–A10 每个 replay 都有命名 owner test；nested sync 显式跳过有 owning test；每个 source-only translator 行都先登记 capture gate。
s4.uncoveredBoundaries: named exclusive sync skip 仍是隐式 default-drop（C4 实现项）；selected variant 无同版本样本（C3 前置缺口）；vision remains future，不进入 supported acceptance tests。

s4.name: Kernel live
s4.invariant: 一个 canonical event 最多推进一次 Kernel chain；execution 只从 authoritative status/error/idle 终结；`kernel==nil → projection.Apply` 是要封死的第二 reducer；HTTP 204 与 timeout 不得制造 completion。
s4.producerProof: EventPublisher.publish 在 publisher lock 下调用 kernel.IngestLive；每个 logical event 恰好 append 一条记录（existing TestEventPublisherAppendsExactlyOneRecordPerLogicalEvent）。
s4.reducerFenceProof: revision 只在 projection commit 时推进（existing TestProjectionRevisionAdvancesOnlyOnProjectionCommit）；kernel==nil fallback 待 seal（planned TestKernelNilProjectionApplySealed）。
s4.deliveryClientProof: 缺 terminal 保持 running/failed；零输出 idle 暴露 turn error（existing TestSSEZeroOutputIdleSurfacesTurnError）；catalog gate 零 POST（existing TestSendCatalogGateIsZeroPOST）。
s4.sampleEvidence: A3（provider retry/error 终态）、A4（abort 终态 MessageAbortedError→idle）、A1/A2（authoritative idle 终态）真实序列回放。
s4.negativeAssertion: 无 timeout-completion；204 仅 admission；缺 terminal 不得推断成功；history/status 不得绕过 Kernel 直接写 timeline。
s4.exitCondition: kernel-nil seal 与 history/status 不可绕过均有 owning test；terminal 只来自 authoritative 证据有 A3/A4 回放证明。
s4.uncoveredBoundaries: kernel==nil fallback 代码仍在（sealed 状态待 C4 落地删除/测试封印）。

s4.name: Kernel hydrate
s4.invariant: cold history 只进 private hydrate transaction（source cut/fence 下）；hydrate 期间 pending live 按序补追；commit 后 push/pull 是同一个 Kernel head；不进 EventBuffer、offline queue、mailbox 或 raw fanout。
s4.producerProof: opencode-web rich history 经 streamBackendRichHistoryProjectionEvents 只走 ApplyHydrateEvent（existing TestOpenCodeWebProjectionHydrateFromRichHistory）。
s4.reducerFenceProof: hydrate 事务 Begin/Apply/Commit 原子提交；checkpoint admission/invalidation 受控（existing TestProjectionCheckpointAdmissionAppendAndInvalidation）；restore 校验 schema（existing TestProjectionCheckpointRestoreValidAndEmpty）。
s4.deliveryClientProof: commit 后 Snapshot 为唯一 payload；live cold pull 在 busy probe 下只提交 running partial（existing TestOpenCodeWebLiveSessionColdPullWithBusyProbeCommitsRunningPartial 在 reconnect 行引用；本行 owning 为 hydrate-from-rich-history + prefers-by-id）。
s4.sampleEvidence: A1/A2 reload 的 persisted messages；A5 重连的 hydrate facts；by-id get（A10 archived 会话）。
s4.negativeAssertion: hydrate 不得进入 ordinary live seq、EventBuffer、live buffer、offline queue、mailbox、raw client fanout；不得让客户端自行 merge get_session_messages。
s4.exitCondition: pending-live 按序补追、push/pull 同 head、不进 buffer 三者各有 owning test。
s4.uncoveredBoundaries: 当前代码已满足架构，但 pending-live 顺序与 buffer 隔离尚无命名 owning test（planned 三项）。

s4.name: reconnect
s4.invariant: generation/epoch mismatch 拒绝 stale frame；gap/invalidate 只拉 get_session_projection；恢复使用同一个 (backendId, sessionId) Kernel；iOS 不得调用 history merge、content similarity 或 completion timer；A5 busy→server.connected→live delta→idle 必须有 owning test。
s4.producerProof: 进程 epoch 注入 EventPublisher 并跨 hello/register 一致（existing TestServerInjectsProcessEpochIntoEventPublisher、TestConcurrentHelloConnectionsShareProcessEpoch）。
s4.reducerFenceProof: checkpoint schema 不匹配即拒绝（existing TestProjectionCheckpointRejectsPreviousSemanticSchema）；validate/invalidate/rehydrate 都在同一 Kernel。
s4.deliveryClientProof: 旧 session 的 projection 响应不改当前 timeline（iOS existing testOldSessionProjectionResponseDoesNotMutateCurrentTimeline）；SSE drop 后 heal（existing TestSSEStreamReconnectsAndHealsAfterDrop）。
s4.sampleEvidence: A5 真实序列：busy-at-disconnect；第二条 SSE 首帧 server.connected 然后 live message.part.delta（续流非快照）；terminal idle；reload finish=stop。
s4.negativeAssertion: 不得从空 reload status 合成 finish=stop；不得 iOS history merge / content-similarity dedup / 本地 completion timer；gap 只能走 get_session_projection。
s4.exitCondition: A5 序列 owning test 存在；epoch mismatch 拒绝 stale frame 有 owning test；iOS reconnect 不回调 loadMessages 有 owning test。
s4.uncoveredBoundaries: A5 owning test 与 epoch-mismatch 拒绝测试均为 planned（C4 实现项）。

s4.name: delivery
s4.invariant: SSV2 connection 不接收 raw timeline writers；control-plane allowlist 明确且不携带 timeline payload；projection snapshot/patch/invalidate 只走现有这一条 websocket delivery path；push 丢失后 pull 返回同一 Kernel head。
s4.producerProof: shouldDeliverRawEventLocked 对 SSV2 连接封印 raw timeline；分类由 TestSessionSyncV2RawTimelineClassification 固定。
s4.reducerFenceProof: patch 只投给 V2 连接（existing TestProjectionPatchDeliveredToV2ConnOnly）；canonical user_input projection-only 且 legacy 单向派生（existing TestCanonicalUserInputIsProjectionOnlyAndLegacyIsOneWayDerived）。
s4.deliveryClientProof: control-plane raw 仍可达 projection-only 连接（existing TestProjectionOnlyConnStillReceivesControlPlaneRawEvents）；无订阅者不 crash（existing TestProjectionPatchNoSubscriberNoCrash）；iOS push 旁路 recovery cursor（existing testProjectionPatchPublishesDespiteRecoveryCursorAhead）。
s4.sampleEvidence: A1/A5 的 delivery 序列（patch/snapshot 到达 iOS 的 envelope 与现有 websocket 一致）。
s4.negativeAssertion: raw text_delta / question_* 不得发给 SSV2；不得出现第二 projection 管道；control-plane 事件不得夹带 timeline payload。
s4.exitCondition: push-lost→pull-same-head 有 owning test；raw 封印与 allowlist 分类维持 existing 覆盖。
s4.uncoveredBoundaries: push 丢失后 pull 同 head 的直接断言是 planned。

s4.name: iOS ownership
s4.invariant: ownership 在 t=0 由 mode + selected backend capability 决定（非 projection 到达）；loading/empty/failed/invalidated 不恢复 legacy writer；loadMessages gate 必须发生在 cache/snapshot/network 读取之前；OpenCode Web 属于 projection backend family。
s4.producerProof: active mode 在选择时即持有 timeline（existing testActiveModeOwnsAtSelectionBeforeProjectionArrives）；off mode 保留 legacy（existing testOffModeKeepsLegacyOnly）。
s4.reducerFenceProof: capability 按 backend 收敛（existing TestSessionSyncV2CapabilityScopedToMigratedBackend；server.go advertiseSessionSyncV2Backend 含 opencode-web）。
s4.deliveryClientProof: loading 只启动有界 disaster retry（existing testLoadingProjectionStartsOnlyBoundedDisasterRetryTask）；transient disconnect 保持 loading 不出 banner（existing testOffModeTransientBridgeDisconnectKeepsEmptyHistoryLoadingWithoutBanner）；history fallback 复用原事务策略（existing testHistoryFallbackAndRetryReuseOriginalTransactionPolicy）。
s4.sampleEvidence: A1 首开会话；A5 断连状态机（loading/invalidated 不回 legacy）。
s4.negativeAssertion: loading/empty/failed/invalidated 不得触发 loadMessages、replaceMessagesFromServer、get_session_messages 兜底或 delayed raw flush。
s4.exitCondition: opencode-web t=0 ownership 与 gate-before-reads 顺序各有 owning test。
s4.uncoveredBoundaries: opencode-web 专属 t=0 断言与 gate 顺序断言为 planned（C4/C1 实现项）。

s4.name: iOS application
s4.invariant: 只有 ProjectionStore 应用 full/delta/push；baseRev→syncRev、fence、generation/epoch 与 stale frame rejection 持续生效；submit path / composer placeholder / HTTP 204 不写 messages[]（submit-zero-writer），只有后续 projection apply 才写；placeholder 仅 presentation-only。
s4.producerProof: guard 测试封印外部双 writer 并要求 ProjectionStore 持有与 applyFrame 泵模型（existing testSessionSyncV2GuardsExternalDualWriters）。
s4.reducerFenceProof: 低 rev snapshot 不得重开已解决卡片（existing testStaleLowerRevSnapshotDoesNotReopenResolvedCard）；gap recovery 对齐权威 snapshot（existing testGapRecoveryRealignsUserInputCardToAuthoritativeSnapshot）。
s4.deliveryClientProof: baseline 前的 patch 不渲染、baseline 到位后 reconcile（existing testPatchesBeforeBaselineDoNotRenderThenBaselineReconciles）；无 baseline 不裁决（existing testNoAdjudicationWhileUnresolved）；snapshot/invalidate 旁路 cursor（existing testProjectionSnapshotAndInvalidateAlsoBypassCursorGate）。
s4.sampleEvidence: A1/A2（persisted user message 与 projection 对齐）、A9（parts 映射不入 messages[] 的本地路径）。
s4.negativeAssertion: composer placeholder 不得写/确认/覆盖/裁判 active timeline；204 不是 turn_completed；不得出现 optimistic/history/raw 第二 writer。
s4.exitCondition: submit-zero-writer、placeholder presentation-only、baseRev→syncRev fence 各有 owning test。
s4.uncoveredBoundaries: 三条 planned test 尚未落地（C3 实现项）；ProjectionStoreTests.swift 文件名按 Gate C 落位时可调整，但必须先建 owning 文件。

s4.name: interaction
s4.invariant: permission raw control 不写 timeline、canonical permission 只归约一次、reject 不是健康完成；question 只走 canonical user_input_requested/resolved、legacy question frame 不进 Kernel 也不发给 SSV2；todo 只在 control-plane、绝不进 SessionProjection、不造 hash/content/position ID；A6/A7/A8 的 request/reply/reject/reload 都有 owning test；capability 只在完整真实路径后广告。
s4.producerProof: handlePermissionAsked 只产 core.EventPermissionRequest；todo.updated phase-1 显式忽略（existing TestSSETodoUpdatedIgnoredInPhase1）。
s4.reducerFenceProof: permission pending tool + requires action（existing TestReducerPermissionRequestProjectsPendingToolAndRequiresAction）；resolved 清 pending 保持 running（existing TestReducerPermissionResolvedClearsPendingAndLeavesRunning）；deny 拒绝 tool（existing TestReducerPermissionResolvedDenyRejectsTool）。
s4.deliveryClientProof: canonical user_input projection-only、legacy 单向派生不回 Kernel（existing TestCanonicalUserInputIsProjectionOnlyAndLegacyIsOneWayDerived）；iOS 五状态恰好一张卡（existing testSnapshotRoundTrip_AllFiveStatusesMapToExactlyOneCard）；当前 question 面为 ErrNotSupported 诚实缺席（existing TestQuestionsNotSupported）。
s4.sampleEvidence: A6（once/always/reject + replied/resolved + reload）、A7（asked/reply answers:string[][]/reject/resolved/reload）、A8（todo.updated + GET /todo {content,status,priority} 无 id）。
s4.negativeAssertion: reject ≠ 健康完成（A6 finish=tool-calls、A7 idle、pending cleared）；不发明官方 question_resolved；permission 不得折叠为 question；todo 不进 SessionProjection、不合成 ID；完整路径存在前不广告 capability。
s4.exitCondition: A6/A7/A8 request/reply/reject/reload 全部有 owning test；三类所有权各有 negative test。
s4.uncoveredBoundaries: question/todo 路径当前为诚实缺席（ErrNotSupported / phase-1 ignore）；全部 planned tests 为 C6 实现项。

s4.name: cross-repository
s4.invariant: 协议顺序 canonical-first：Mac docs/protocol/schema → Go types → iOS mirror/Swift/web types → capability advertisement；C1–C7 判定 no protocol change 的 slice 必须有 guard test 证明没有私自新增 wire field；若 Gate C 后来需要协议变更，必须先完成 canonical-first 双仓 tests 才能广告；capability flag 只能在完整 Mac+iOS 路径与相关测试通过后开启。
s4.producerProof: hello/hello_ack fixture 走 bridge-v1 schema 解码与往返（existing TestBridgeV1HelloFixtureDecodes / TestBridgeV1HelloAckFixtureRoundTrips）。
s4.reducerFenceProof: capability 按 opt-in 广告/省略（existing TestSessionSyncV2CapabilityAdvertisedOnOptIn / TestSessionSyncV2CapabilityOmittedWithoutOptIn）。
s4.deliveryClientProof: opencode-web WireDescriptor 恰为 external_turn_streaming、无 todos/question_reply（existing TestWireDescriptorMatchesDesign）——证明 OD-3 extras 未实施且未广告。
s4.sampleEvidence: None（结构守卫行）：证据为 schema fixture 与 WireDescriptor 测试本体。
s4.negativeAssertion: OD-3 十四项（sessions.fork/share/unshare/children、turns.command/shell/summarize/revert/unrevert、workspace.session_diff/vcs/file_list/file_read/file_search）与 vision 保持 future/unsupported：未实施、未广告、无 owning implementation acceptance；不得私加 wire field 或在完整路径前开 capability flag。
s4.exitCondition: no-undeclared-wire-field guard 与 OD-3 未实施未广告断言均有 owning test；任何 Gate C 协议变更先走 canonical-first 双仓 tests。
s4.uncoveredBoundaries: 双仓协议变更流程仅在 Gate C 真正需要协议变化时触发（当前仅 C3 条件性 send-RPC 字段）。
